heading: Scholarships & recognition

featured.name: Truman Scholar
featured.tip_text: The national scholarship for college juniors committed to careers in public service, with up to $30,000 toward graduate study.

featured.name: Morehead-Cain Scholar
featured.tip_text: UNC’s full merit scholarship, considered the nation’s first, covering four years plus summer enrichment programs.

featured.name: Udall Scholar
featured.tip_text: A federal scholarship for undergraduates committed to careers in the environment, tribal public policy or Native health care.

featured.name: Coca-Cola Scholar
featured.tip_text: A national scholarship for about 150 graduating high school seniors chosen for leadership, service and academic promise.

featured.name: Andrews Fellow in Environmental Policy
featured.tip_text: UNC Public Policy’s fellowship for a rising senior dedicated to environmental policy research and service, named for Professor Pete Andrews.

featured.name: Kathy A. Taft Award for Education Policy
featured.tip_text: Recognizes a public policy senior dedicated to education policy. Named for a longtime member of the North Carolina State Board of Education.

more.name: Buckley Public Service Scholar
more.tip_text: UNC’s public service distinction: 300 hours of service, a service-learning course and a senior reflection project.

more.name: Carolina Research Scholar
more.tip_text: A UNC designation for undergraduates who complete research methods coursework and hands-on research.

more.name: Honors Carolina Laureate
more.tip_text: The distinction for completing the honors program’s coursework and requirements.

more.name: Agora Fellow
more.tip_text: A selective group of 20 UNC students who study civil discourse and moderate campus dialogue through the Program for Public Discourse.

more.name: Carolina Diplomacy Fellow
more.tip_text: A UNC program for building diplomacy knowledge, skills and career pathways.

more.name: Bejarano-Benning Scholar
more.tip_text: A UNC scholarship supporting undergraduate study abroad in Latin America. Awarded for my semester at the Pontificia Universidad Católica de Chile.

earlier.name: U.S. Presidential Scholar
earlier.tip_text: Honors about 160 graduating high school seniors nationwide for academic achievement, leadership and service.

earlier.name: National Merit Scholar
earlier.tip_text: National recognition for top scorers on the PSAT/NMSQT among high school students.

earlier.name: Teen Vogue 21 Under 21
earlier.tip_text: Teen Vogue’s annual list of young changemakers, activists and artists making a substantial impact in their communities and the world.
